role: Real two-key enforcement extending the existing Synchronous Gate HITL pattern — requires genuinely different approvers via real Set-based uniqueness, not just a raw count. The same person approving twice cannot fake reaching the threshold.
behaviorDescription: checkApproval() counts unique approver IDs via a real Set, verified against the same-person-twice case before implementation. Configurable required-approval count, default 2.
hardStops: Never counts the same approver ID more than once toward the required threshold
Never approves with fewer than the real, configured number of unique approvers
